[SWS_Lin_00140] ⌈If development error detection for the LIN module is enabled: the
function Lin_Wakeup shall raise the development error LIN_E_STATE_TRANSITION if
the LIN channel state-machine is not in the state LIN_CH_SLEEP.⌋
Note: The Lin driver’s environment shall only call Lin_Wakeup when the LIN channel is
in state LIN_CH_SLEEP.
